30 min – 2 hours (depends on how many spirits you catch)

The scientists of the Edron Academy, {npc:Spectulus} and {npc:Sinclair}, founded the Spirithunters and want to study ghosts. You take measurements in a graveyard, test the {item:Spirit Cage} on a {creature:Ghost} and then capture Ghosts, Nightstalkers and Souleaters. You gain experience, platinum coins and the achievement **Afraid of no Ghost!**, and you can repeat the hunt every day.
Sinclair needs someone to catch spirits for him with a Spirit Cage, for a macabre investigation.
No minimum level; level 70+ recommended (for Nightstalkers and Souleaters).
Food and {item:Health Potion|health potions} for missions 2 and 3
5 Ghosts + 5 Nightstalkers + 5 Souleaters: 10,000 experience + 60 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}
you keep it for the daily task
After mission 3: once a day, {key:research} and {key:yes} to Sinclair.
Same rewards as mission 3. You keep the {item:Spirit Cage}; if you don't take it with you, he gives you a new one.
Only **exact groups of 5** per species count: 4 Nightstalkers, for example, are worth nothing.
You can only trap Nightstalkers once you have 5 Ghosts in the cage, and Souleaters once you have 5 Ghosts and 5 Nightstalkers.
If you lose the {item:Spirit Cage}, say {key:lose} to {npc:Sinclair} to get another one.
Go to the **Edron Academy** and talk to {npc:Spectulus}. Say {key:hi}, {key:task}, {key:research} and {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Magical Measurement Device} (the *spirit meter*).

Go to the graveyard **northeast** of Edron and use the {item:Magical Measurement Device} on **all** the graves (4/4). Each use makes a {creature:Squidgy Slime} appear. The graveyard is outdoors: when you finish, walk back the same way to the Edron Academy.
Go back to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:research} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:task} and {key:research} to {npc:Spectulus}. He sends you to fetch the cage from Sinclair and use it on a common ghost.
Go down to {npc:Sinclair} (one floor below Spectulus). Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Spirit Cage}.
Find a {creature:Ghost}, kill it and use the {item:Spirit Cage} on the corpse **right after** it dies.
Go back to {npc:Sinclair} with the ghost in the cage and report the mission.
Say {key:research} and {key:yes} to {npc:Sinclair}. You need at least 5 Ghosts; you earn more with 5 Nightstalkers and even more with 5 Souleaters.

Kill them and use the cage on the corpses, **in this order**: first 5 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, then 5 {creature:Nightstalker|Nightstalkers} and finally 5 {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}. You can stop after any complete group.
Watch out for the other creatures that live in those places.

Go back to {npc:Sinclair} and say {key:research}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. The reward depends on the complete groups you brought. You also get the achievement **Afraid of no Ghost!** (even if you only bring 5 Ghosts).
Experience + platinum coins + achievement Afraid of no Ghost!

You keep the {item:Spirit Cage}. Once a day you can ask {npc:Sinclair} again ({key:research}, {key:yes}) for the same task as in mission 3, with the same rewards. If you don't bring the cage, he gives you a new one.
